decisions.statement: A tick takes away the page of every window that is no longer open.
No page whose window is still open is taken away by a tick.
A tick judges a window's process the way a seat's holder process is judged.
A tick sweeps the main checkout rather than the tree the service runs from.
A tick that finds every window open writes nothing.
A page taken away goes as a commit, so what it was stays in history.
A tick names every page whose slug states no process rather than guessing.
A tick turns the sweeping module's own sweep rather than a sweep written again.
A tick that cannot run at all carries its fault out and fails the unit.
How often a tick runs bounds how long a closed window's page stays up.
No page's age is read to decide what goes.

definition: the service taking away the page of every editor window that is no longer open
